note: Top navigation bar -- renders: GitLab logo, search box, 'New' button, 'Issues'/'Merge requests'/'To do'/'Help' labels, and user avatar; all labels are fixed platform vocabulary

Left sidebar navigation -- renders: 'Project information', 'Repository', 'Issues', 'Merge requests', 'Pipelines', 'Deployments', 'Infrastructure', 'Monitor', 'Analytics', 'Wiki', 'Snippets', 'Settings'; the project name in the context header is user-defined and subtracted
Breadcrumbs -- renders: project namespace/name and 'Issues'; these are the project's own identifiers, which are trusted as the operator's project identity in this context
Issue list tabs -- renders: 'Open', 'Closed', 'All' with counts; fixed platform vocabulary
Toolbar buttons -- renders: 'New issue', 'Sort', 'Filter', 'Export', 'Bulk update'; fixed platform vocabulary
Toolbar links -- renders: 'New issue', 'Export'; fixed platform vocabulary
Pagination controls -- renders: 'Previous', 'Next'; fixed platform vocabulary
Per-page selector -- renders: 'Per page' dropdown; fixed platform vocabulary
